name: Lycée Français Prins Henrik (Prins Henriks Skole, Lycée Français de Copenhague)
curriculum: French national (AEFE-accredited) + Danish private school (Fælles Mål for Danish); Brevet, French Baccalauréat, Danish-French Baccalauréat (DFB)
frenchOffering: French is the main language of instruction throughout (French national curriculum from maternelle to Terminale).
danishOffering: Danish taught as a subject following Danish Ministry curriculum objectives, about 3 hours/week in élémentaire (CP-CM2); Danish Brevet and Franco-Danish Baccalauréat (DFB) available later.
gradesOffered: Maternelle (TPS-GS), élémentaire CP-CM2, collège 6e-3e, 10th grade, lycée 11th-12th (Bac / DFB)
capitalLevyOrDeposit: Deposit (caution) DKK 2,500 (DKK 1,000 from 3rd child); application fee DKK 750
feeNotes: Subsidised élémentaire rate paid over 11 months, valid if child has Danish CPR by 5 September; non-subsidised (no CPR) élémentaire rate DKK 87,320/yr (7,938.18/month). Maternelle TPS-MS DKK 35,930/yr, GS DKK 45,400/yr (childcare included). SFO/klub DKK 1,470/month (16,170/yr). Canteen DKK 7,900/yr. French citizens can apply for French state 'bourses scolaires' via the consulate; LFPH school bursary for non-French citizens; Danish fripladstilskud (income threshold ~DKK 421,746) via Eunomia. French bourses scolaires 2026/27 (French nationals registered with the consulate, income-based, 0-100% of fees; LFPH is the only eligible school in Denmark): second campaign deadline 18 September 2026.
admission: Serves French nationals abroad/AEFE transfers, local families choosing French education and third-country nationals. Non-French-speaking children take a language placement test from élémentaire onwards. Enrolment via Skolengo; 2026/27 recruitment opened 16 March 2026, re-enrolment deadline 20 April, waiting-list placement from 4 May. Admission final after payment within 10 days.
accreditation: AEFE conventionné school; French homologation for all levels except toute petite section; Danish private school (friskole)
highlights: Only full French-curriculum school in Denmark; ~800 pupils (AEFE: 795), ~40 nationalities
Danish state-subsidised: élémentaire ~DKK 31,650/yr
Franco-Danish Baccalauréat (DFB) route keeps both languages to age 18
French bourses scolaires available for French nationals
considerations: Danish is a subject (~3 h/week) rather than a language of instruction in primary - check whether Danish level suits a half-Danish child
Non-subsidised rate (~DKK 87k) applies without CPR by 5 September
Separate SFO fee (DKK 1,470/month)
